d:
This fanzine is printed via blueprint copy method vs what I initially thought was a mimeograph. This information was given to me by the JP side of the fandom and lead me to inspect it further and do additional research on the piece itself. Robin in Kanto was one of the first Rainbow Sentai Robin FCs and features the very extreme talents of several young women, alongside advertisements for other circles in the area as well as fanclubs. I acquired this from Moriya a few months ago off of YJA.

This particular group faciliated meet-ups with like minded Robin fans all across Japan even though they were located in Kanto.

Editing mimeographs and blueprint copies are exceedingly hard, however, we managed to work it out by gently debinding and working on each page with tools. The effect seen is the result with an adjustment layer, hand cleaning etc. The paper is severely brittle, damaged and yellowed, so at present, this is the final result. Future endeavors will be taken should new tools be available, but each page was handled with literal and figurative white gloves and is stored in a climate controlled environment.
